configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: TSLANG custom language requires the Ninja generator (the Visual Studio generator ignores custom languages).

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Ninja is a single-config generator, so Release builds use their own binary directory.

configurePresets.name: default-rc
configurePresets.description: TSLANG custom language requires the Ninja generator (the Visual Studio generator ignores custom languages).

configurePresets.name: release-rc
configurePresets.description: Ninja is a single-config generator, so Release builds use their own binary directory.

configurePresets.name: dlss
configurePresets.description: Debug with NVIDIA DLSS (DONUT_WITH_DLSS): Donut fetches the DLSS SDK from GitHub at configure time, and this project the DLSS-NR (DLSS 5) SDK (DONUT_WITH_DLSS_NR, ~370 MB).

configurePresets.name: release-dlss
configurePresets.description: Release with NVIDIA DLSS (DONUT_WITH_DLSS) and DLSS 5 (DONUT_WITH_DLSS_NR).

configurePresets.name: dlss-nr
configurePresets.description: Debug with NVIDIA DLSS-NR (DONUT_WITH_DLSS_NR, which needs DONUT_WITH_DLSS): Donut fetches the DLSS-NR SDK from GitHub at configure time.

configurePresets.name: release-dlss-nr
configurePresets.description: Release with NVIDIA DLSS-NR (DONUT_WITH_DLSS_NR, which needs DONUT_WITH_DLSS).

configurePresets.name: default-rtxcr
configurePresets.description: Debug with DLSS-NR and the rtxcr_pathtracer and rtxcr_raster examples (RTXCR_DIR: a checkout of github.com/NVIDIA-RTX/RTXCR with submodules and assets). Override the path with -DRTXCR_DIR=<path>.

configurePresets.name: release-rtxcr
configurePresets.description: Release with the rtxcr_pathtracer example (RTXCR_DIR: a checkout of github.com/NVIDIA-RTX/RTXCR with submodules and assets). Override the path with -DRTXCR_DIR=<path>.

configurePresets.name: android-x86_64
configurePresets.description: Release for Android x86_64 (the emulator), API 29, Vulkan only. Needs ANDROID_NDK_HOME, and a desktop build first for its ShaderMake.

configurePresets.name: android-arm64
configurePresets.description: Release for Android arm64-v8a (devices), API 29, Vulkan only. Needs ANDROID_NDK_HOME, and a desktop build first for its ShaderMake.

configurePresets.name: android-arm32
configurePresets.description: Release for Android armeabi-v7a (32-bit devices), API 29, Vulkan only. Needs ANDROID_NDK_HOME, and a desktop build first for its ShaderMake.
